title: あと一部屋の宝袋
concept: 扉の敵・宝・拾い物を見て進む八部屋の洞窟。剣は一戦ごとに弱くなり、強敵の先の武器が欲しくなる。体力を使って多く持ち帰るか、今の宝で帰るか。手に入れた宝が増えるほど引き返しにくくなる欲張りを核にした。
howToPlay: 扉をタップすると敵から「敵の強さ−剣」の傷を受け、宝と拾い物を得て剣が1消耗します。一部屋進めばいつでも帰還でき、体力が尽きると宝を失います。
libraryDecision: 共有棚を確認し、使用しない。見えている三択と消耗する資源の比較が核であり、物理や3Dの揺らぎは判断を曖昧にする。音も短い結果通知に留め、Web Audioで作る。
soundDecision: 無傷・被弾・帰還・敗北に小さな高さの違う三角波を鳴らす。BGMや時間を急かす音は入れず、ゆっくり扉の数字を比べられるようにする。

candidates.idea: 敵・宝・拾い物の三択と消耗する剣。宝袋を持ち帰るか、次の部屋へ欲張る八部屋の洞窟。
candidates.ideaEn: Eight rooms of visible foes, loot and supplies with a wearing sword. Bring the treasure home or risk one more room.

candidates.idea: 夜空の星を結び、通した形に応じて渡り鳥の群れが飛ぶ観察の遊び。
candidates.ideaEn: Connect stars into shapes that guide a migrating flock.

candidates.idea: 船の左右に荷物を積み、波の周期に合わせて岸へ荷を滑らせる港の仕事。
candidates.ideaEn: Balance cargo on a boat and slide it ashore in time with waves.

en.title: One More Room
en.concept: Choose among visible foes, treasure and supplies through eight rooms. A sword wears down each fight, tempting you toward a dangerous replacement. Push deeper for a bigger bag or head home now: accumulated treasure makes retreat emotionally harder.
en.howToPlay: Tap a door: take max(0, foe minus sword) damage, gather loot and supplies, then lose one sword strength. Return any time after one room. Running out of health loses all treasure.
en.libraryDecision: Reviewed the shared shelf and chose no libraries. Comparing three visible options and depleting resources is central; physics or 3D uncertainty would obscure those decisions. Short result sounds use direct Web Audio.
en.soundDecision: Soft triangle tones distinguish an unhurt room, damage, returning and defeat. No background music or urgency cues: take your time comparing the door numbers.

aiReview.comment: 17手を画像で見て、6部屋で40の途中帰還と、再開後8部屋で63の最奥帰還を確認した。傷・剣の消耗・回復は読み取れる。ただ、回復や補充が豊富で一択が他を明らかに上回る場面が多く、欲張りと撤退の迷いが弱い。武器の「3に」は取得直後の値で、その場の消耗後は2になる点も少し紛らわしい。遊べるが判断の深さと緊張感は不足。敗北画面までは到達していない。

similar.title: Card Crawl
similar.note: 敵・武器・回復・金を数字でやり繰りする短い洞窟探索が近い。本作はカードの山や装備枠をなくし、一部屋ごとの三択と任意帰還に絞った。
similar.note_en: Both are compact dungeon crawls managing numbered foes, weapons, healing and gold. This version removes the deck and equipment slots, focusing on three doors and voluntary retreat.

similar.title: Dungeon Cards
similar.note: 毎回変わる敵や物資を選んで生存と得点を両立する点が似る。本作は盤上移動でなく一方向の八部屋で、宝を確定して引き返せる。
similar.note_en: Both balance survival and score by selecting changing foes and supplies. Here there is no spatial grid: eight one-way rooms allow banking treasure by retreating.

aiReview.research: Card Crawlの公式Steam掲載と、Dungeon Cards開発元の説明を2件の検索クエリで確認。数値資源をやり繰りする系譜を明記し、本作の三択・任意帰還・短さとの違いを比較した。

en.comment: Viewed all 17 steps: banked 40 after six rooms, restarted, then returned from all eight rooms with 63. Damage, sword wear and healing are readable. However, generous supplies and frequently dominant options weaken tension between greed and retreat. A sword pickup says 'to 3' before immediate wear leaves 2, which is slightly confusing. Functional but lacking depth and pressure. The defeat screen was not reached.
en.research: Used two search queries and verified Card Crawl's Steam listing and Dungeon Cards' developer page. Compared their numerical resource-management lineage with this game's three-door choices, voluntary retreat and short runs.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 17 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 17 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 敵と剣の差が傷になるという説明を読んだ。まず扉の三択を見る。
playLog.noteEn: The instructions explain damage as foe minus sword. Start to inspect the three doors.

playLog.note: 中央は傷2だが体力+3と宝9。回復で埋められそうなので選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: The middle costs 2 HP but heals 3 and offers 9 gold. Choose it to offset the damage.

playLog.note: 体力は満タン、剣は1に減った。左で剣を補充し、次の傷を抑えたい。
playLog.noteEn: Health is full but the sword fell to 1. Take the left replacement to reduce future damage.

playLog.note: 補充後すぐに消耗するので剣は2。中央なら傷1で宝8と剣を保てる。
playLog.noteEn: The replacement wears immediately, leaving sword 2. The middle offers 8 gold and another sword for 1 HP.

playLog.note: 体力8で三択とも傷0。次の回復を期待して、宝5の右へ進む。
playLog.noteEn: At 8 HP all doors are harmless. Take the right door for 5 gold, hoping for later supplies.

playLog.note: 右より左が同じ宝5で傷0、剣も補充できる。左を選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: The left has the same 5 gold as the right, but no damage and a replacement sword. Choose left.

playLog.note: 宝30、体力8。右の傷3と引き換えに宝10を狙い、帰還判断の圧力を試す。
playLog.noteEn: With 30 gold and 8 HP, risk the right door's 3 damage for 10 gold and test the pressure to retreat.

playLog.note: 宝40・体力5、次は傷4で宝10の誘惑がある。今回は40を確定して持ち帰る。
playLog.noteEn: At 40 gold and 5 HP, a 10-gold door costs 4 HP. Bank the 40 instead of risking it.

playLog.note: 6部屋で宝40を持ち帰れた。再開して別の洞窟の扉も見てみる。
playLog.noteEn: Returned with 40 gold after six rooms. Restart to inspect the next cave's doors.

playLog.note: 初手の扉は同じ配置。再び回復つきの宝9を取り、二部屋目の変化を見る。
playLog.noteEn: The opening layout repeats. Take the healing 9-gold door again and inspect room two.

playLog.note: 二部屋目は前回と違う。傷2を払って宝7と剣を拾い、今回は奥まで狙う。
playLog.noteEn: Room two differs from the last run. Pay 2 HP for 7 gold and a sword, aiming deeper this time.

playLog.note: 右は傷1で回復3と宝8。体力を戻せる有利な扉を選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: The right costs 1 HP but heals 3 and gives 8 gold. Take this favorable recovery door.

playLog.note: 傷2でも左は宝8と剣補充がある。中央より得なので左へ。
playLog.noteEn: The left costs 2 HP but offers 8 gold and a sword. It dominates the middle, so choose left.

playLog.note: 左は傷0で回復3と宝7。補給が多く、危険を回避するのは難しくない。
playLog.noteEn: The left offers healing and 7 gold without damage. Frequent supplies make avoiding danger fairly easy.

playLog.note: 右は傷0で剣も戻る。深い部屋でも好条件が続くので進む。
playLog.noteEn: The right has zero damage and a new sword. Favorable choices continue even in the depths.

playLog.note: 左と中央は同じ宝8で剣補充。傷が少ない左を選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: Left and middle both offer 8 gold and a sword. Choose the left for less damage.

playLog.note: 前の左は剣補充ではなく回復で、体力9・剣1になった。最後は傷5でも生き残れるので宝10を取る。
playLog.noteEn: The previous left door healed rather than replacing the sword: now 9 HP and sword 1. The last door's 5 damage is survivable, so take 10 gold.

metrics.method: Codexのtoken_usage_recordをresponse_idで重複除去し企画開始から自己判定完了まで集計。入力はキャッシュ込み、出力は思考を控除。ツールはトップレベル呼出のみ。
metrics.methodEn: Aggregated unique Codex response usage from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning; tools count top-level calls.
